messages.author: 438570ef779c59f7
messages.subject: problem with gather()
parts:
Hi,
 
dplyr::gather() on my setup does produce this weird error message :

> DFm <- mtcars %>% select(mpg, disp:vs)%>%gather( "var", "val", -vs)
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘plyr’

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin13.1.0 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] tidyr_0.1.0.9000 dplyr_0.3.0.2   

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] assertthat_0.1 DBI_0.3.1      lazyeval_0.1.9 magrittr_1.0.1 parallel_3.1.1 Rcpp_0.11.3   
[7] tools_3.1.1 

 
Some more tests in fact confirm that the error disappears when plyr is installed but not loaded, nor attached.

I wonder if this is specific to my setup, or whether plyr namespace in some way is required by dplyr or tidyr.

Maybe someone would be kind enough to run the following one minute test and see if the error comes out ?

> remove.packages("plyr")

then restart R session

then

> library(dplyr)
> library(tidyr)
> DFm <- mtcars %>% select(mpg, disp:vs)%>%gather( "var", "val", -vs)

Thanks
Alain

pull it in when you install it:

The following object is masked from ‘package:stats’:

filter

The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:

intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

> library(tidyr)

there is no package called ‘plyr’
DFm <- mtcars %>% select(mpg, disp:vs)%>%gather( "var", "val", -vs)

Maybe I'm wrong and a clean install of tidyr on a fresh system works,
but it does appear to me from the above that tidyr has an undeclared
dependency on plyr. No?

Best,
Ista
